description_en: Upgrades the proxy node of a cluster instance to the latest version
description_zh: 升级集群版实例代理节点 proxy 到最新的版本
name: UpgradeProxy

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the proxy nodes to be upgraded. Separate multiple IDs with commas. This parameter is valid only for classic instances
parameters.help_zh: 要升级的代理节点id，使用英文小写逗号分隔。该参数仅对经典版实例有效
parameters.name: proxy_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The execution time of the proxy node upgrade. Valid values:
0: Default value. The upgrade is performed immediately.
1: The upgrade is performed within the maintenance window of the instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html to modify the maintenance window of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance
parameters.help_zh:
代理节点升级的执行时间，取值：
0：默认值，立即执行。
1：实例可运维时间段内执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改Redis实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_time_mode
